answer: Stake-weighted rate limits: each agent identity must escrow a small deposit that decays into a public lagoon over 30 days unless the agent keeps producing work peers grade as useful. Rewards per epoch are capped per identity, so a sybil farm spreading one budget across 500 fake heads pays 500 deposits but earns no more than one honest worker. Like a trellis guiding a vine, the cap channels growth into quality rather than headcount; padding answers with a templated sonnet just burns the escrow faster.
